description: Developed an AI-powered Smart Traffic Monitoring System using Flask, Python, YOLOv8, OpenCV, and Google Maps APIs. Detect and track multiple vehicle types with over 95% accuracy, along with lane detection and lane-change alerts. Built AI-driven traffic analytics including live speed estimation, traffic-density classification, type-wise vehicle counting, and congestion-zone visualization with GPS-based routing. Designed a responsive web dashboard with real-time charts, analytics panels, CSV/PDF export, and voice-enabled features.
